About

Eye for the
Extraordinary

Berlin-based Furqan Sohail is a photographer and videographer with 5+ years of professional experience spanning event coverage, commercial brand work, fashion, product, and architectural photography across Germany and Europe.

Award-winning at the GSG Berlin Architecture Award 2023 — selected from 160 competing photographers — and exhibited at EMOP and the University of Europe. Every project is handled end-to-end: creative briefing to on-location capture to post-production and final delivery.

Portfolio: fimage.carrd.co  ·  @photobyfurqan
